01 · The list

Food and drink,
level by level

Food and drink words in Chinese: meals, dishes, ingredients, drinks, the verbs for eating and drinking, and the words you use in a restaurant. All from the HSK vocabulary lists with readings and meanings.

In Lock&Learn Chinese these words sit in their level packs (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 5), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

菜càidish or vegetableHSK 1我喜欢吃中国菜。Wǒ xǐhuān chī Zhōngguó cài.I like to eat Chinese food.
茶cháteaHSK 1我想喝一杯茶。Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi chá.I would like to drink a cup of tea.
吃chīto eatHSK 1我们去饭馆吃米饭。Wǒmen qù fànguǎn chī mǐfàn.Let's go to the restaurant to eat rice.
饭馆fànguǎnrestaurantHSK 1我想去这家饭馆。Wǒ xiǎng qù zhè jiā fànguǎn.I want to go to this restaurant.

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

What are common food words in Chinese?

The 17 words below are every food and drink word on the HSK vocabulary lists, each with its reading and English meaning, beginner words first.

Which HSK levels are these words from?

9 from HSK 1, 7 from HSK 2, 1 from HSK 5. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, pinyin and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn food and drink words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. Enable the level packs these words come from (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 5). A word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
